defs.def: （要求得到更多信息）究竟，到底

ex.s: Catherine Murphy, a cafe worker in a green shirt and black hat, makes sure that each customer gets exactly what they order.
ex.t: Catherine Murphy是一名穿着绿衬衫、戴黑帽子的咖啡馆员工，她确保每位顾客都得到自己点的东西。

ex.t: 例如，面对两份工作邀请，我们可能会想知道，我们究竟在两者之间做出怎样的选择。

defs.def: （答语，表示赞同或强调正确）一点不错，正是如此，完全正确

ex.s: That’s exactly what is happening in small neighborhoods around the country from Orange County, California, where 22 measles cases were reported this month, to Brooklyn, N.Y., where a 17-year-old caused an outbreak last year.

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: Though both of these men were ultimately successful, their paths to success were very different, their futures not necessarily turning out exactly as they planned.
ex.t: 虽然这两个人最终都取得了成功，但他们通往成功的道路大相径庭，他们的未来也未必完全按他们计划的那样发展。
